correctness.rationale: Every one of 4096 binary states was evaluated under the exact update for each of 25 graphs using independent Python successor-path and C++ indegree-peeling algorithms, both replayed from included paths. It is a complete finite proof, no sampled-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: All 24 single-edge perturbations of a canonical 12-vertex extremal triangle-free four-chromatic quartic network are classified with exact natural state-invariant basins and transient clocks. The universal strict increase of unanimous attraction despite reduction of recurrent states and occasional increase to eleven-step relaxation is graph-structural, nonmonotonic on general graphs, and an intrinsically complete motivated finite classification rather than an arbitrary slice.
